threshold_review_rule: For each configuration, eligible percentiles must have clean B0007 FPR <= 0.05 for every seed. Suggest the lowest eligible percentile for review only. If none qualifies, return no recommendation. Never use synthetic metrics in this rule; never finalize automatically.
display_reference_note: Declared before fitting, used only to keep narrative and plots readable; not a selected or final model.
metric_policy: Primary precision/F1 and average precision (PR-AUC) use equal total clean and synthetic class weights (50% evaluation prevalence). Recall and clean FPR are unweighted within class. Report raw instance precision/F1/AP too. ROC-AUC compares all eligible positive copies with the full feature-eligible clean B0007 trajectory. Overlapping windows are dependent, not independent replicates.
score_convention: anomaly_score = -IsolationForest.score_samples(StandardScaler.transform(X)); larger means more anomalous; anomaly iff score > threshold
